display_long_description:
*Graphics are optimized for the Quest 3

This is an F/A-18 Hornet Aircraft Carrier landing simulator exclusively for Meta Quest. 

Experience the thrill of landing on an Aircraft Carrier.  Strap in and take command of the legendary F/A-18 Super Hornet in F/A-18 Carrier Landing.  

Master the thrill of landing on an aircraft carrier.
Feel the adrenaline, the precision, and the pressure—just like real Navy pilots do.

Key Features:

🛫 Realistic F/A-18 Cockpit

🌊 High Detail Ocean Graphics: Fly over an ocean environments with dynamic waves and lighting

🎮 Full VR Touch Controls: Reach out, grab the throttle, flip switches, and steer with lifelike responsiveness

🎯 Landing Grading System: Receive detailed performance feedback on every carrier landing

🏆 Global Leaderboard: Compete with pilots around the world for the best landing scores

Whether you're a flight sim veteran or a VR enthusiast looking for the next-level challenge, F/A-18 Carrier Landing delivers a true taste of naval aviation like never before.

Do you have what it takes to stick the perfect carrier landing?

Take flight and find out.
